title: Demon Path Alliance
next_chapter_hook: At the very moment the two parties struck palms in oath, a low sigh echoed from the depths of the Void—was it a warning from the Heavenly Eye, or the mockery of some far older existence?

text.content: The moment his consciousness returned to his body, Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes. Amidst the world spinning, he discovered an unprecedented light deep within his Mental Sea—a third path he himself had opened, a possibility to escape the fate of twin chess pieces. However, before he could savor this breakthrough, the Void suddenly tore apart. A familiar yet strange aura pressed through the rift, carrying the Demon Path's unique chill and诡谲. "Interesting." The voice echoed from all directions simultaneously; squinting, Chen Ji watched as the Demon Path commander materialized from the rift, those deep eyes now devoid of past killing intent—merely cold, calculating assessment.

dialogue.content: The Demon Path commander stood with hands behind his back, demonic energy churning around him like a tide, yet his voice remained terrifyingly calm: "Chen Ji, that momentary aura of yours... the third path this seat has pursued for countless ages—you've actually found it."

text.content: Chen Ji rose slowly, brushing non-existent dust from his robes, a faint smile curling his lips: "You're too kind, senior. If I recall correctly, during our last meeting you恨不得将我挫骨扬灰. How is it that in an instant, your attitude has changed so dramatically?" His tone was light and carefree, as if discussing today's weather. But secretly, his divine sense had already spread like spider silk, capturing every trace of energy fluctuation around him.

dialogue.content: The Demon Path commander showed no anger, instead laughing softly: "A wise man knows when to yield. Chen Ji, both you and I are pieces on fate's chessboard—no, to be precise, twin pieces controlled by the Universal Will. Your struggle against me is merely internal friction among chess pieces."

text.content: The Universal Will. These four characters struck like a basin of ice water over his head, Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracting. Of course he knew the weight of this term—that was an existence beyond the Heavenly Eye, the true Chess Player of this universe. At this moment, the Tianji Record Fragment trembled slightly in his Mental Sea, as if sensing something. Meanwhile, a faint fluctuation came from the depths of the Void, carrying a heart-stopping pressure—the Heavenly Eye's warning.

dialogue.content: That fluctuation directly resounded in Chen Ji's Mental Sea: "Do not trust lightly... the twins... are all..." The voice came in fragments, as if disturbed by some force. But the final character was crystal clear—"...enemies."

text.content: Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, yet within his heart, monstrous waves were already churning. The Heavenly Eye's warning could not be ignored, but what the Demon Path commander said also held merit—if the Universal Will truly was their common enemy, what meaning would the distinction between good and evil still have? However, Chen Ji never believed in free lunches. The Demon Path commander's proactive friendliness at this moment must have deeper motives behind it.

dialogue.content: The Demon Path commander seemed to see through Chen Ji's thoughts, saying indifferently: "You're doubting this seat's motives? No matter. This seat can speak plainly—the final judgment of Cang Yutian approaches, and，届时 the Heavenly Eye will fully awaken. If we continue fighting amongst ourselves, we will only become sacrificial offerings to the Universal Will."

text.content: "So what the senior means is—" Chen Ji drew out his words, "before becoming offerings, join hands to deal with the greater threat?" The Demon Path commander nodded: "Smart. The Universal Will treats us as twin chess pieces, but we may not be unable to overturn the chessboard. You possess the Tianji Record, this seat has the Demon Path's accumulation of countless millennia. Joining forces, we might carve out a bloodied path." Chen Ji remained silent for a moment, then suddenly laughed: "Insightful words, senior. Only this junior has one thing unclear—how can you be certain this junior would trust someone who has repeatedly tried to end my life?"

choice.prompt: Faced with the Demon Path commander's alliance proposal, Chen Ji fell into contemplation. Was this an opportunity to break the局, or an even deeper trap?

choices.description: Share risks and benefits, temporarily set aside grudges before the Universal Will.
choices.visible_cost: Need to expose some hidden cards
choices.visible_reward: Gain Demon Path resource support, strengthen chips for opposing the Universal Will
choices.risk_hint: The Demon Path commander's credibility remains doubtful, if betrayed would face attacks from both fronts

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slightly nodded: "What the senior says makes sense. Since neither of us has a way out, temporarily joining forces is acceptable. But let me be clear—if there are any ulterior motives, this junior's retaliation will not be as polite as today."

choices.description: Not promising a comprehensive alliance, only conducting interest exchanges in specific areas.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain independent judgment space, not be unilaterally bound
choices.risk_hint: The Demon Path commander may consider the sincerity insufficient, reducing cooperation depth

dialogue.content: Chen Ji pondered for a moment: "The matter of alliance, allow this junior to consider further. However, if the senior has need of intelligence, this junior can offer some cooperation. After all—" he glanced meaningfully at the other party, "the enemy of my enemy may not be a friend, but at least can be not an enemy."

choices.description: Maintain an independent stance, without any entanglement of interests with the Demonic Path.
choices.visible_reward: Not being restrained by the Demonic Path forces, maintaining freedom to advance or retreat
choices.risk_hint: Facing the cosmic will alone brings immense pressure, and the Demonic Path commander-in-chief's attitude may reverse

dialogue.content: Chen Ji shook his head: "Your kindness, Senior, is appreciated. But this junior has grown accustomed to traveling alone. Regarding allying with the Demonic Path, I must respectfully decline." Though his tone was humble, his gaze was firm as iron.

text.content:
Just then, a brilliant light erupted from the depths of the Void. Chen Ji and the Demonic Path commander-in-chief both changed complexion—the aura of the Heavenly Dao's Eye, over ten times stronger than before.

"It's warning you." The Demonic Path commander-in-chief narrowed his eyes, "It seems it doesn't want to see our alliance any more than I do."

Chen Ji coldly smiled: "Senior might consider it from another angle—if it opposes so strongly, doesn't that prove this path has possibility?"

dialogue.content: Upon hearing this, the Demonic Path commander-in-chief's eyes flashed with brilliance: "Good! I was indeed not mistaken about you." He stepped forward, the demonic energy around him suddenly收敛, replaced by an unprecedented solemnity, "Chen Ji, I ask you one final time—will you establish this fragile alliance with me?"

text.content:
Chen Ji gazed at this former adversary with whom he had fought to the death, his heart churning with countless thoughts. He recalled Su Qingyao's vacant eyes, the warning from the Heavenly Dao's Eye, the vague prophecies within the Tianji Record...

Eventually, he lifted his head, eyes blazing: "Since you sincerely invite, Senior, this junior shall accept without further hesitation. But let me be clear—this alliance is built on mutual benefit, with non-betrayal as the bottom line. If either party strikes first, the other has the right to unilaterally dissolve the contract."

The Demonic Path commander-in-chief nodded: "Only right."

choice.prompt: The alliance terms are set, but the specific depth of cooperation still requires confirmation. Chen Ji must make choices in the following areas:

choices.description: Establish an information exchange mechanism, but retain core capabilities. Each takes what is needed, refraining from interfering with each other's specific operations.
choices.visible_cost: Need to share partial foresight content
choices.visible_reward: Gain support from the Demonic Path intelligence network, anticipating the cosmic will's movements in advance
choices.risk_hint: Intelligence exchange may be exploited by opponents

dialogue.content: Chen Ji said calmly: "Since we are allies, intelligence sharing is the primary necessity. If Senior has visions requiring foresight, inform this junior and I shall do my utmost. And regarding the Demonic Path's布局 in the dark world, I hope Senior will generously share insights."

choices.description: Mutual assistance at critical moments, but each fights independently in normal times. Maintain independence, go all-out during emergencies.
choices.visible_cost: May be forced into Demonic Path disputes
choices.visible_reward: Gain powerful backup, have capital for reversal at critical moments
choices.risk_hint: Combat power mutual assistance means deep binding of interests, may be dragged into the mire

dialogue.content: Chen Ji pondered deeply: "Fighting alone is ultimately too weak. If Senior encounters strong enemies, this junior will surely lend all strength to assist; and if this junior faces difficulties, I hope Senior won't stand by indifferently."

choices.description: Only cooperate against the cosmic will, this common enemy. Non-interference in other matters.
choices.visible_reward: Maximize autonomy, avoid being tied to the Demonic Path's war chariot
choices.risk_hint: Limited scope of cooperation may be viewed by the Demonic Path Commander as insufficient sincerity.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's expression remained calm: "Alliance is alliance, cultivation is cultivation. The junior only cares about one thing—how to survive the judgment of the Universal Will. Other matters can be discussed after this calamity passes."

text.content:
The Demonic Path Commander stared at Chen Ji for a long while, then suddenly burst into laughter: "Good! Good one, Chen Ji! No wonder the Tianji Record chose you—such a temperament balancing caution and resolve is indeed the key to breaking the deadlock."

As the laughter faded, he flicked his finger and a pitch-black token came flying through the air, landing steadily in Chen Ji's hand. "This is the Demonic Path Holy Token. Holding this token allows you to command one-third of my shadow guards. From now on, you and I are equals in alliance."

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path Commander's voice suddenly lowered, carrying a rare gravity: "But this one must remind you of something—the warning from the Eye of Heavenly Mandate is not baseless. It says the twins are both enemies because you and I are both part of the Universal Will's grand design. No matter our choices, we cannot escape the fate of being pieces."

text.content:
Chen Ji grasped the token, feeling the immense demonic energy contained within, and a meaningful smile curved his lips. "Pieces, you say?"

He softly repeated these two words, his gaze fixed on the depths of the void—where the fluctuations of the Eye of Heavenly Mandate grew increasingly intense, as if a slumbering beast was awakening.

"Does the senior know what distinguishes a piece from a chess player?" Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his voice calm yet carrying undeniable confidence.

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path Commander raised an eyebrow slightly: "Oh? This one would be delighted to hear the details."

text.content: Chen Ji tucked the token into his sleeve and said word by word: "Pieces can only wait passively, but a chess player can actively set up the game. What the junior intends to do is become the one who overturns the entire chessboard."

choice.prompt:
The moment the words fell, an intense fluctuation suddenly came from the depths of the void. The pressure of the Eye of Heavenly Mandate surged forth like a tide, carrying anger and... a trace of imperceptible fear?

The Demonic Path Commander's pupils contracted slightly, and his gaze toward Chen Ji held genuine wariness. "That aura you just manifested—"

"The senior sees correctly." Chen Ji said coolly, "The junior has indeed found a third path. A path that does not belong to the fated twins. And this path—the Universal Will... cannot see."

choices.text: Chen Ji unexpectedly revealed his biggest trump card. The Demonic Path Commander's reaction will determine the trajectory of this fragile alliance:
choices.description: Since cooperation has been chosen, reveal more trump cards to show sincerity, allowing the Demonic Path Commander to completely dispel any doubts.
choices.visible_reward: Gain genuine trust from the Demonic Path Commander, solidifying the alliance
choices.risk_hint: If betrayed after all trump cards are revealed, there will be no escape

dialogue.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, and an arcane pattern slowly emerged at his brow center. That was the mark of the third page of the Tianji Record, his true trump card. "Senior, please observe—" He opened his eyes, his pupils reflecting countless intertwined threads of fate, "This is the junior's third path."

choices.description: Stop at the right moment; the information revealed is enough to make the Demonic Path Commander wary, but not enough for him to discern all the trump cards.
choices.visible_cost: The Demonic Path Commander may still hold back
choices.visible_reward: Maintain an air of mystery, making the other party dare not act rashly
choices.risk_hint: If the Demonic Path Commander feels insufficient sincerity, he may reduce the depth of cooperation

dialogue.content: Chen Ji smiled faintly, dissolving the pattern at his brow center into nothingness. "The senior merely needs to know that the junior's path can evade the observation of the Eye of Heavenly Mandate. As for the specific mysteries—that can wait until you and I have truly built trust."

choices.description: Never mention the specifics of the third path, redirecting the conversation toward the upcoming judgment of Cangyutian.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the Opportunity to Consolidate the Alliance
choices.visible_reward: Guard the core secret, leaving no potential threats
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path Commander's curiosity is piqued, and he may investigate privately.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji shifted the topic: "Enough small talk. Since you mentioned Cang Yutian's Final Judgment, do you have any detailed intelligence? When will the Heavenly Eye awaken, and what manner of layout will there be at that time? Please enlighten me, Senior."

text.content:
The Demonic Path Commander cast a deep glance at Chen Ji, as if weighing the weight of his words. In the end, he did not press further, merely saying indifferently: "Very well, everyone has their own secrets. This One only asks you one thing—on the day of Cang Yutian's Judgment, are you willing to fight side by side with This One?"

Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then nodded solemnly: "As long as you do not betray me, Senior, I will not betray you. In this battle, we advance and retreat together."

As his words fell, both men extended their palms simultaneously, striking hands in a solemn vow.

dialogue.content:
The crisp sound of the palm strike echoed through the Void, carrying an indescribable binding force. A complex light flickered in the Demonic Path Commander's eyes, then transformed into a sigh: "Chen Ji, this One has lived for countless years and witnessed countless geniuses fall. You are the first to make This One feel that 'perhaps the chessboard can truly be overturned.'"

He turned, tearing through the Void to depart, yet at the final moment looked back: "Three days before Cang Yutian opens, This One will send someone to contact you. During this time, prepare well."

text.content:
Before the words even finished, the Demonic Path Commander's figure had vanished into the Void's rift. Chen Ji stood alone, gazing at the gradually healing fissure, a meaningful smile curving at the corner of his lips.

"Trust, you say..."

He murmured to himself, then lowered his gaze to the Demonic Sacred Token hidden in his sleeve. The demonic patterns on the token were flickering subtly, as if transmitting some kind of hidden information.

And deep within the Mental Sea, the Tianji Record Fragment slowly unfurled—the third path he had just opened was radiating a faint yet steadfast light—the hope of escaping fate's chess game, and the only road leading to true freedom.

However, just as everything seemed settled, a low sigh suddenly echoed from the depths of the Void.

That voice was ancient and vicissitudinous, as if from the very birth of the cosmos, yet as if it had just descended. Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply—that was the fluctuation of the Heavenly Eye, but stronger than any previous time.

It was not warning—it was... watching.

Chen Ji felt a bone-deep chill. He suddenly realized that perhaps both he and the Demonic Path Commander had underestimated the terror of the Universe's Will. That existence transcending all was, in a manner transcending time, observing every single one of their choices.

"Interesting."

Chen Ji murmured to himself, yet the light in his eyes burned ever more resolute.

"Since you are watching, then please watch clearly—the chess game you personally set up is about to be overturned by your very own chess pieces."
